items.q: So we go on the Orpheum circuit on bills with Frances White and Walker

ctx.x: you'll be out drinking and I'll come home drunk." This gag. He missed this trick. "Ladies and gentlemen, I had to be at Carnegie Hall the other night, two gentlemen asked me if I'd insist them running their recital in vaudeville so I thought I'd run them along. Are the gentlemen there? I think one of them plays a flute in four feet deep of rice pudding. Buck and Bubbles? Bring them on." Here we come. I told you how we're dressed. Okay. On. That's how we got on the act. Now we do our song and dance and we burned it.

So we go on the Orpheum circuit on bills with Frances White and Walker -- Walker-- can't think of his first name. And there are quite a few acts on the bill. However, However, we played the Orpheum circuit to California, we got into California and we got an audition to do for the Pathe' Studio, we got an audition for Pathe' Studio and we got a chance to make some Hugh Wiley shorts.
